name: MASt3R Feature Integration
definition: A state-of-the-art 3D foundation model that learns to establish correspondences in feature space between pairs of images of the same scene. It takes two input images and predicts a dense pointmap and stereo feature image corresponding for each input image.
summary: MASt3R Feature Integration enriches stereo matching cost volumes with deep multi-view features to improve depth estimation and mesh reconstruction accuracy.
